skills.name: Shackle
skills.text: Pang Tong can use any club hand card to Chain two people together or activate the redraw function.

skills.name: Nirvana
skills.text: Once per game, when Pang Tong is on the brink of death, he may discard all of his cards, draw three new ones, and return with three units of health.

source.site: English Sanguosha (Jason Keeney and Scott Maresh)
